categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong King-Strong Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on two main business segments: special application electronic business and special application materials business. The electronic business includes RF microwave power amplification, filtering, frequency sources, signal sources, receiving, frequency conversion, low slow small target detection radar, and related circuit modules, components, devices, and systems. The materials business involves thermal spray materials, electromagnetic wave absorbing materials, structural absorbing materials, carbon fiber reinforced resin composites, and anti-corrosion electrostatic conductive materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced RF microwave technologies including broadband high-reliability RF power amplification, synthesis, coupling, switching, and filtering technologies. It also utilizes micro-assembly and system-in-package (SiP) technologies for frequency source and signal source products. Production methods include plasma spraying and explosive spraying for thermal spray materials, and customized order-based manufacturing for electronic and material products, adhering to strict national standards for special applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are research institutes and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in defense, aerospace, communication, electronic countermeasures, radar, satellite communication, and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sectors. The company serves both military and civilian markets, including emerging fields like low-altitude economy, satellite internet, and domestic large aircraft manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and production facilities located in Foshan, Guangdong Province. It is expanding efforts to develop overseas markets to build a dual circulation business development pattern.
categories.supply_chain_position: King-Strong operates mainly as a midstream and upstream supplier, providing specialized RF microwave modules, components, and materials to downstream military and civilian equipment manufacturers. It acts as a key component and module supplier within the defense industrial chain, with strong integration in the RF microwave value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in RF microwave power amplifiers, frequency sources, signal sources, and low slow small target detection radars. It is advancing micro-assembly and SiP technologies, developing new products for UAVs, satellite communications, and electronic warfare. King-Strong also focuses on expanding special application materials like thermal spray and absorbing composites. Strategic initiatives include talent acquisition, technology innovation, digital transformation, and external investment or acquisitions to strengthen its industrial and capital platform.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized and standardized products to institutional customers. The company follows an order-based production model, with some pre-production for high-demand standard products. Sales contracts are typically long-term and price-controlled, especially in military applications, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: King-Strong holds a leading position in China's special application RF microwave and materials sectors, with subsidiaries like Kuangpu Technology and Renjian Microwave recognized as industry leaders. The company competes mainly with large state-owned enterprises and a few qualified private firms in the defense industry. It benefits from high entry barriers, technical certifications, and stable customer relationships, maintaining competitive advantages through technology, quality, and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 480.65 million, a slight decrease of 5.96% from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 120.29 million, down 13.58%. Total assets reached about RMB 2.09 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.71 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion, despite short-term market fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: King-Strong emphasizes its comprehensive RF microwave solutions with high reliability, broad frequency coverage, and advanced integration technologies tailored for special applications. Its products fill domestic gaps and replace imports in critical defense and aerospace sectors. The company also offers specialized materials with superior performance in thermal protection, electromagnetic absorption, and anti-corrosion, supporting enhanced survivability and operational effectiveness of military and civilian equipment.
